data.gender_notes: Nurayda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nur' meaning 'light' and 'Ayda' meaning 'night'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the light that guides through the darkness of life. The name Nurayda carries the meaning “Light of the night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nurayda usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of guidance and light in one's spiritual journey.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nurayda total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nurayda represents a theme widely prevalent in Islamic literature which is the interplay of light and darkness. This name is often given to girls born in families who aspire for their children to be lighthouses of guidance and wisdom in their communities. In various forms of Islamic art, the contrast of light against the darkness is used as a metaphor to highlight the purity and goodness in individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nurayda holds immense spiritual value in Islamic culture. It reflects the belief in the power of divine guidance that illuminates even the darkest of situations in one's life. Similarly, it draws reference to the concept of the 'night journey' of Prophet Muhammad where he was believed to have journeyed from Mecca to Jerusalem and then to the 'Farthest Mosque' (Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa) in Jerusalem. During this journey, he was accompanied by angels, and it signified a spiritual elevation of the Prophet. Thereby, this name symbolizes the spiritual journey of an individual towards enlightenment and closeness to God.
